description: Fetches Mexican recipes from Rick Bayless's official website (www.rickbayless.com), including ingredients, instructions, and recipe metadata.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_recipe: 获取单个食谱详情，需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - list_recipes: 获取食谱列表; 参数: page; 必填: 无
  - search_recipes: 搜索食谱，需要query参数; 参数: query; 必填: query

url.description: 食谱页面的完整URL (用于get_recipe功能)
